data.summary: This week, Ethan Qiu made 32 GitHub contributions across 25 pushes. Most of the activity was in UTMIST/Misty with 24 contributions, along with 5 in qiuethan/Portfolio and 3 in qiuethan/now. He opened pull requests in UTMIST/Misty (#263, #265, #267, #269), qiuethan/Portfolio (#1–#6), and qiuethan/now (#1–#3), and reviewed pull requests in UTMIST/Misty (#230, #258, #259, #261, #262, #264, #268).
